_comment: Reference for the OTHER way to render an .obj: Forge's own forge:obj model loader,
through the vanilla block/item pipeline. Point a blockstate at this and the model
becomes an ordinary block model - it gets vanilla's per-face diffuse shading and its
textures must live in an atlas, so there is no metallic, no smoothness and no probe.
Use this when you want an .obj shaped block that behaves like any other block.
Use HypergraphicalAPI.spawn for PBR, arbitrary coordinates and reflections.
This file is inert on its own; nothing references it.
